verdict.rationale: Sumsub documents a REST API for processing applicant data and an official MCP server that lets AI agents perform operations under existing role-based permissions, directly supporting agent-driven session creation and data retrieval with scoped credentials. However, the evidence doesn't explicitly confirm polling outcomes, triggering re-checks, or granular per-agent credential scoping (only account-level role permissions) via the MCP surface, and no independent/hands-on validation of the MCP server's actual capabilities exists. missing for 10: explicit documentation of poll/re-check operations via MCP or API, fine-grained scoped-credential mechanics for agents, independent verification of MCP server functionality.
